verdict.rationale: Dynadot is a SaaS registrar that holds customer data and offers AI features (AI domain search, an MCP server), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI-training data use, an opt-out, or a data-usage policy. The privacy evidence covers only WHOIS contact masking and account security, which is a different privacy axis.
